surface_mechanism_description: Ligand exchange between TMA and surface hydroxyl groups followed by water pulse to regenerate OH sites
evidence: Using this trial-and-error method and the STRATA program, we found that a film grown from TiCl4 and H2O at 100°C contained 7.2 ±0.7% m/m of chlorine and 6.9 ±0.9% m/m of hydroxyl groups. Therefore, the composition of this film can be described as (TiO2)0.6[TiCl0.5(OH)3.5]0.4.
